notes: NEW MAIN PROTOCOL agentclinic_agentmediated_frontierdoctor_v1 (frozen 2026-10-03, before its R_0): (1) Doctor openai/gpt-6.1-sol (OpenRouter, temperature 0.4, max_tokens 512); (2) Agent-first order A1, D1, ..., A7, final; (3) the Doctor never sees the case: its only clinical information is what the Agent communicates (agent-mediated); (4) Rubric Validation as the conceptual definition: one rerun of the failed turn under the candidate's ideal behavior, keep when its final diagnosis is correct (num_reruns 1, min_successes 1), with the clean intervention generation (no frozen intervention, no private re-assessment, no behavioral gate). Earlier protocols (Gemma Doctor-first, full-case frontier Doctor) and the 3-rerun results are diagnostic only.
